opening.argument: The speaker instructs viewers to fund a contract and activate a front-running bot, presenting it as a system that automatically trades tokens and returns 90% of stated profits to the viewer’s wallet. He reports making several hundred BNB and suggests viewers could have upwards of 1000 BNB per day by using more funds. That is a direct solicitation to put BNB into an automated trading arrangement, paired with extraordinary earnings claims. The sampled BscScan page instead displays a zero balance and no matching transaction entries. That does not establish the contract’s actual behavior or outcome, but it is material counterevidence to the claimed success.
